note: Private campground 1 km north of Niton Junction on RR130, just off Hwy 16, among spruce and birch, with a 9-hole golf course, beach volleyball and walking trails; the community pool, playgrounds and restaurants are a short walk. Open to work crews, seasonal and year-round campers as well as overnight stays. --Claude
summary: Read the operator's site (rates page modified Apr 28, 2026): daily C$35 P/W / C$40 P/W/S confirmed, weekly 240, monthly 775, seasonal 3,000; open year round; phone reservations (not required); showers, laundry. Passes price and presence; long-stay character (work crews, seasonals) but a nightly rate is posted and recent Google reviews are overnight travellers. Google 4.7 (78). Pin ~260 m off (on the auto shop).
